correctness.rationale: The all-face projection reduces to a simplex Lagrange multiplier with nonnegative optimizer; the swap calculation selects the largest coordinates. The gap identity gives an explicit positive-root backward inverse. Dirichlet–gamma independence and exponential spacings give the finite harmonic mean. A Poisson upper-order-statistic limit and concentration of the denominator and quadratic norm give the joint gamma-log law. All numerical checks use the new package code and supplement, rather than substitute for, the proofs. Boundary cases and fixed-j quantifiers are explicit.

value.rationale: A complete skeleton-distance signature is a natural geometric inverse measurement across all face dimensions. The theorem classifies exactly what it identifies (signed-permutation orbits), gives a constructive inverse, and determines a coherent non-Gaussian high-dimensional distribution family for quantization error at every fixed face rank. These are structural and probabilistic results beyond a single coordinate-max exercise.
